title: DECLARED MECHANICS SMOKE FIXTURE - wall law v2.2 'merge-release'
created_utc_source: owner-approved laptop smoke <= 3 x 300 sim-s; the reconstructor runs it, never the proposer

law.dmin_formula: D_min = X + v_wall*(t_assemble + H_min) = 0 + v_wall*(10 + 60) = 70*v_wall m

deployment.target_repo: E:/research-dense (READ-ONLY for the proposer; the reconstructor applies the patches)

unchanged.sensing.py: no functional change (frames already carry lane/edge identity + lane-local position); sha recorded in PATCH_SHAS.json

preconditions: apply the four patches to the live files (LF; never modify the network or frozen evidence)

finalize the J4B v2.2 registration at output/campaign_walls_v1/results_plan/WALLS_PILOT_REGISTRATION_V22.md (write-once; content = REGISTRATION_WALL_V22.md + the J4B draft's launch blocks) - the J4 registration file is frozen and is NOT touched
runs root runs/campaign_walls_v22_smoke must NOT exist (write-once smoke; never data)
no other campaign running in the window (same discipline as the J4 smoke)

selection.rule: a-priori from the J4 analysis geometry ONLY (request/assembly/hold records of TRAIN worlds; NO outcome fields): TRAIN split, registered hold draw 240 s (so the merge-start cap, not the draw, ends the hold), lead assembled far enough upstream that v2.2 D_min = 70*v_wall admits the request with positive margin AND the predicted merge-start arrival (assembled_at + (2644.2 - lead_s_road_assembled)/v_wall) fits one 300 sim-s horizon with >= 100 s slack

command_notes: cwd = E:/research-dense; one command per run, run SEQUENTIALLY (laptop smoke); --horizon-ticks 300 caps each branch at 300 sim-s; NO --hold-override-s (the registered 240 s draws stay as drawn so the merge-start cap is what ends the hold); the child refuses an existing run dir (write-once)

checks.MC1_assembly_upstream_of_merge: wall_events.jsonl has an 'assembled' wall_event; every wall_member_lanes row BEFORE the merge_release tick shows both members on edge 1191554636
checks.MC2_merge_release_at_point: branch_record.json: outcome == 'merge_released'; exactly ONE wall_event merge_release in wall_events.jsonl with release_point_s == 2644.2; branch_record lead_s_road_at_release_m >= 2644.2 and < 2644.2 + wall_speed_mps (<= one control tick of travel past the point); NO wall_member_lanes row with a member on edge 1487606179 or 1487606178 BEFORE the release tick (no member reaches the merge edge before the release)
checks.MC3_zero_member_left_network: no wall_event safety_abort with reason member_left_network anywhere; no other safety_abort at all expected (a v2.2 smoke run with any safety_abort FAILS)
checks.MC4_hold_cap_logged: wall_events.jsonl has exactly one hold_cap row: requested_hold_s == 240.0, capped_at_merge is true, effective_hold_s == merge_release timestamp - assembled timestamp < 240.0, cap_point_s == 2644.2; branch_record hold_capped_at_merge is true and merge_release_s is set
checks.MC5_receipt: RUN_RECEIPT.json exit_status == 'complete', load_state_calls == 1, horizon_mode == 'smoke_cap', executed_time_s == 600 physics rows (300 sim-s x 2)

pass_rule: ALL of MC1-MC5 for EACH of the three runs; any FAIL stops the fixture (no retry in the same runs root; a re-smoke uses a NEW runs root and is registered as such). Smoke runs are NEVER data and never read as outcomes.
